intro.summary: Inner-city community on the escarpment directly north of downtown, with skyline views along Crescent Road and more apartments and condos than houses.
intro.body: Crescent Heights sits on the bluff directly north of downtown across the Bow River, with Crescent Park and McHugh Bluff giving it some of Calgary's best-known skyline views. It is one of the city's older neighbourhoods. Early 1900s houses share its streets with walk-up apartments and newer condo buildings.
